baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative أَيَحْسَبُ governs the negated proposition أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُ أَحَدٌ: the subject's own estimate attempts to establish that every possible seer is absent.
baseline_models.mechanism: A private supposition constructs a zero-witness condition. The exhaustive force of أَحَدٌ enlarges this from one missing eyewitness to an erased class of sensory or insightful observers, while the object pronoun in يَرَهُ makes the reckoner himself the exposed object.

activation_trace.role: Supposition supplies a provisional inner estimate and functions as the mental act that posits an observerless condition.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the denied relation and makes both sensory notice and perceptive recognition live.
Exhaustive anyone under negation expands the supposed absence across the whole class of possible witnesses.

changed_reading.before: A rhetorical question asks whether he believes nobody literally watched him.
changed_reading.after: The question diagnoses self-exemption: his own uncertain estimate tries to erase every sensory and insightful witness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counting branches of يَحْسَبُ and أَحَدٌ meet inside a proposition whose practical witness count is zero.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah can be modeled as a defective ledger. The subject performs a reckoning, enters no single observer in the account, and is then made reckonable by the very question that exposes this omission.

activation_trace.role: Counting and accounting turn the subject's belief into a ledger-like computation rather than a free-floating feeling.
One in counting supplies the missing unit whose absence lets the subject enter a witness total of zero.
Actual or insightful seeing is the event that would falsify the zero entered in that ledger.

changed_reading.before: He simply imagines that he is unseen.
changed_reading.after: He has entered the witness count as zero; the question reopens that ledger and makes his reckoning itself subject to reckoning.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The grammar lets the subject reckon while denying that any counterpart occupies the seeing side of يَرَهُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mutual visibility is broken into an asymmetry: he remains an assessing subject but imagines himself unavailable as another's object. The isolation branch of أَحَدٌ makes this a self-made blind spot rather than simple physical darkness.

activation_trace.role: Supposition gives the subject the unilateral mental position from which he designs the visibility field.
Mutual visibility and facing supply the reciprocal field that his belief attempts to interrupt on only one side.
Isolation individual by individual gives the imagined blind spot its social form: a self detached from every facing other.

changed_reading.before: The issue is one-directional surveillance by an absent observer.
changed_reading.after: The subject imagines an asymmetric world in which he may assess and act while no facing other can return the gaze.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The denied seeing in لَّمْ يَرَهُ can reverse-activate the branch in which conduct is performed to be seen, while يَحْسَبُ can count social merits.
baseline_models.mechanism: Visibility may be the medium in which social credit is minted. By asking what happens when no one sees him, the ayah can strip away spectator-dependent worth and test whether the actor's self-valuation survives without an audience.

activation_trace.role: Counted merits and social standing supply the credit the subject may believe his visible conduct has accumulated.
Showing an act so people see it supplies the spectator economy whose removal tests the act's claimed value.
Exhaustive no one removes every human spectator, not merely a preferred audience.

changed_reading.before: The question concerns conduct hidden from observers.
changed_reading.after: The absence of all spectators becomes a test of audience-made merit: what remains of his self-credit when nobody can applaud the display?

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context builds a sworn, bounded, inhabited, sense-capable field before the focus question. Within that field, 'no one' is not neutral emptiness but an attempted withdrawal from a place where testimony, location, residence, and human perception already intersect.

activation_trace.role: Mutual visibility supplies the focus relation that the civic field makes harder to sever.
Individual isolation names the withdrawal that the surrounding network of place and people resists.
An oath apportioned among its parties supplies a formal testimony frame and makes the later seeing question evidentiary.
A bounded tract supplies a determinate scene in which the subject is locatable rather than placeless.
Dwelling or alighting in a place turns the bounded scene into an inhabited witness field.
Sensing a thing by sight, hearing, or perception supplies human detectability inside that field.

structural_cues: The same city is named in 90:1 and 90:2 before the paired reckoning questions.
The sequence moves from oath, place, and inhabitance to the created human and only then to the subject's claim of observerlessness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sworn speech, a bounded inhabited place, and a human root with sensory detection; I infer that they compose a public evidentiary field around the focus subject. A live alternative is that these cues provide solemn setting and human condition without specifically modeling surveillance.

changed_reading.before: He imagines a private blind spot between himself and an unspecified observer.
changed_reading.after: He attempts to declare himself unseen while already located inside a sworn, bounded, inhabited field of human detectability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-identical question in 90:5 changes only the decisive predicate: no one can exercise power over him becomes no one has seen him. The repetition exposes a possible illicit inference from lack of immediate restraint to lack of observation; latent evidence need not arrive as immediate coercion.

activation_trace.role: Supposition is the repeated mental operator through which the subject conflates two different absences.
Seeing supplies evidentiary presence even when no restraining force is presently visible.
The same supposition branch fixes the mental frame across both questions so the predicate change becomes diagnostic.
Effective capacity, action, and control supply the coercive power that the first question denies.
Exhaustive no one repeats the same universal scope on the power side of the comparison.

structural_cues: 90:5 and 90:7 repeat أَيَحْسَبُ أَن ... أَحَدٌ with يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ replaced by يَرَهُ.
The boast in 90:6 stands between the power question and the sight question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact interrogative frame repeated around a boast, with effective power in the first predicate and seeing in the second; I infer a challenged arrow from 'not restrained' to 'not observed.' A live alternative is that the questions accumulate two independent delusions rather than exposing a causal inference between them.

changed_reading.before: The ayah independently denies that the actor can hide from a watcher.
changed_reading.after: It also breaks his equation of impunity with invisibility: a witness may be present even where sanction is not yet exercised.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direct claim about exhausting piled wealth gives sight a forensic object. The issue becomes correspondence between utterance and event: was wealth actually depleted, how, and with what visible result? The focus question opens an audit without deciding in advance that the boast is false.

activation_trace.role: Accounting turns the follow-up question into scrutiny of a quantitative expenditure claim.
Seeing supplies the observation needed to compare the spoken account with the event.
The branch possibility of saying or attributing what did not occur opens an evidentiary gap without proving that this particular claim is false.
Exhausting effort or spending it out supplies depletion as the claimed event to be checked.
Possessing and accumulating wealth supplies the value-bearing stock in the speaker's account.
A mass piled layer over layer makes the claimed quantity conspicuous and gives the boast measurable weight.

structural_cues: 90:6 is a first-person direct quotation immediately followed by the third-person question in 90:7.
The claim names an action, a valued object, and an emphatic quantity before asking whether anyone saw the claimant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a spoken claim, a branch that permits mismatch between saying and event, depletion, accumulated wealth, and piled quantity; I infer that seeing functions as verification of the boast. A live alternative is that the expenditure occurred exactly as claimed and the question audits its motive or moral value rather than its factual truth.

changed_reading.before: The actor generally believes his conduct escaped notice.
changed_reading.after: A specific self-crediting expenditure claim is placed under audit: who or what can verify the conversion of piled wealth into the event he reports?

context_deltas.mechanism: The next question gives the supposedly unseen man two eyes. This reverses the visual vector: he is not only an object under a possible gaze but an endowed observer whose own capacity to notice is accountable. Watching can also shade into care, so visibility becomes a responsibility he possesses, not only a threat imposed on him.

activation_trace.role: Mutual visibility supplies the reversible relation in which the seen person can also become a seeing counterpart.
Isolation supplies the self-enclosed posture that the bodily endowment breaks open.
Making and bringing a thing about supplies the eyes as a deliberate endowment rather than an accidental capacity.
The observing eye materializes in the subject the very faculty presupposed by the focus question.
Watchful preservation and care let the endowed gaze carry an ethical function beyond bare optical intake.

structural_cues: The consecutive rhetorical questions move from يَرَهُ in 90:7 to the gift of عَيْنَيْنِ in 90:8.
The pronoun shifts from the man as object of seeing to the same man as beneficiary of an observing organ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual visibility, deliberate making, the physical eye, and watchful care; I infer a reversal from 'who sees him?' to 'what is he equipped and obliged to see?' A live alternative is that the eyes function only as evidence of the maker's power and not as an ethical commission to notice others.

changed_reading.before: The gaze is external surveillance directed at the actor.
changed_reading.after: The actor is also an endowed seer: denying the returned gaze exposes his refusal to inhabit a reciprocal and potentially caring field of vision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance, exposed heights, a hazardous incursion, a difficult rise, and knowledge turn seeing into practical legibility. The subject is not merely visible to an observer; alternatives have been made visible to him, and his reckoning can be tested by whether it crosses the costly route.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight supplies the capacity through which a disclosed route becomes actionable knowledge.
Supposition supplies the subject's chosen estimate, now tested against disclosed alternatives rather than hidden facts.
Gentle indication toward a path or truth supplies directional disclosure rather than compulsion.
Emergence and becoming manifest make the two elevated alternatives visually or cognitively exposed.
Perilous incursions and hard roads supply the costly movement that bare awareness has not yet achieved.
The steep difficult rise gives the disclosed choice material resistance and a visible threshold.
Knowledge from the non-dominant mapped root makes explicit the cognitive passage from seeing a route to understanding its demand.

structural_cues: Eyes in 90:8 are followed by guidance to two elevated routes in 90:10.
90:11 reports failure to enter the obstacle, and 90:12 immediately asks what would convey knowledge of it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies eyes, path-guidance, manifest elevation, a dangerous road, a steep threshold, and knowledge; I infer that visible alternatives make the subject's choice legible and answerable. A live alternative is that being seen in 90:7 and seeing a moral route afterward are parallel motifs rather than one causal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies that the actor is hidden from an external observer.
changed_reading.after: It also denies an ignorance alibi: he is equipped for insight and placed before manifest routes, so his refusal of the costly path becomes readable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later 'neck' carries both the direct bodily/legal branch and a branch of watching and waiting. Joined to release from enclosure, it reverses the focus gaze: the man worried about whether anyone sees him is confronted with a constrained person whom someone must notice and free.

activation_trace.role: Seeing supplies the attention whose direction can turn from the actor's exposure toward another person's constraint.
Individual isolation supplies the social condition in which a bound person can remain unattended.
Releasing a pledge or neck from closure and captivity supplies the concrete intervention demanded of the observer.
The neck branch keeps the activation anchored in the explicit object of release.
Watching and waiting cross-activate the neck as a person held under a gaze or awaiting attentive action.

structural_cues: The difficult ascent is first defined by the compact noun phrase فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ.
The focus object pronoun 'him' is later answered by a concrete human body-part standing for a constrained person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release from captivity, the direct neck sense, and a separate watch-and-wait branch; I infer an ethical reversal from being watched to noticing and freeing the watched or waiting person. A live alternative is that رَقَبَةٍ remains purely anatomical/legal here and the surveillance association is only a productive root-level echo.

changed_reading.before: The actor asks, in effect, whether another gaze reaches him.
changed_reading.after: The gaze turns outward: the live test is whether he notices the isolated, constrained person and converts attention into release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later feeding scene supplies an outcome metric for the earlier wealth claim. Piled wealth is not made morally visible by the speaker's declared depletion; it becomes traceable when it crosses into another person's nourishment during severe hunger.

activation_trace.role: Accounting supplies the comparison between claimed outflow and an observable recipient-side result.
Seeing supplies outcome visibility rather than dependence on the spender's self-report.
Spoken utterance supplies the self-authored account whose sufficiency the later outcome tests.
Accumulated wealth supplies the resource stock available for conversion into relief.
Piled mass supplies the boast's quantity and heightens the demand for a commensurate trace.
Feeding another supplies the concrete transfer by which wealth becomes visible outside the claimant.
Hunger joined with exhaustion and famine supplies the urgent recipient condition against which spending acquires weight.

structural_cues: The claim 'I exhausted piled wealth' in 90:6 is later answered by a nominal act of feeding in 90:14.
The later passage names the adverse condition in which transfer would leave a concrete human result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a spoken wealth claim, piled accumulation, feeding another, and famine-hunger; I infer that the later recipient supplies the missing visible trace of expenditure. A live alternative is that the later acts define a separate ideal use of wealth rather than evidence relevant to the earlier claim.

changed_reading.before: The boast is auditable, but the ayah leaves the audit criterion unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The criterion becomes recipient-side and material: did the claimed pile become nourishment precisely where hunger made the transfer costly and visible?

context_deltas.mechanism: The empty class 'no one' is later repopulated by indefinite singular persons: an isolated orphan and an abased poor person, one of them explicitly near. The visual question reverses direction, asking not only who sees the powerful actor but which one-by-one persons he has rendered socially unseen.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight supplies recognition, allowing the visual relation to reverse toward neglected persons.
Exhaustive no one supplies the apparently empty human set that the later singular figures refill.
Isolation individual by individual bridges the focus term to the later socially isolated singulars.
A thing cut off and without its peer supplies singular social isolation as a concrete human condition.
Nearness defeats any spatial excuse for failing to notice the isolated person.
The abasement of destitution supplies a socially lowered person liable to disappear from the powerful actor's field.
Poverty figured as clinging to dust gives that social invisibility a material, ground-level location.

structural_cues: The indefinite singular أَحَدٌ is followed later by the indefinite singulars يَتِيمًا and مِسْكِينًا.
Nearness in 90:15 and dust-level poverty in 90:16 spatialize people whom the subject could fail to recognize.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive anyone, individual isolation, a near isolated orphan, abased destitution, and dust-clinging poverty; I infer a reversal from anxiety about who sees the actor to indictment of whom the actor does not see. A live alternative is that the later persons specify right action without becoming participants in the focus ayah's gaze.

changed_reading.before: The central question is who can see the actor.
changed_reading.after: The later singulars turn the question around: how can he posit 'no one' while failing to recognize one nearby isolated person after another?

context_deltas.mechanism: Trust, reciprocal counsel, sustained commitment, mercy, and preserving companionship form a distributed witness network. This coexists with punitive surveillance but changes its social texture: being seen can mean being held in truthful, patient, merciful relation rather than merely being caught.

activation_trace.role: Mutual visibility supplies the reciprocal relation that the later plural practices socialize.
Isolation supplies the condition overcome by reciprocal counsel and companionship.
Settled security and trust keep communal observation from reducing to hostile scrutiny.
Exchanging counsel among a group supplies a many-to-many accountability circuit.
Bearing a commitment and remaining with it gives that circuit temporal endurance.
Tender mercy supplies the affective mode in which truthful mutual attention can operate.
Preservation through companionship turns witnessing into sustained protective presence.

structural_cues: The reciprocal verb is repeated twice in 90:17 with a plural subject.
The sequence culminates in named companions in 90:18-19, replacing the isolated singular with durable association.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trust, exchanged counsel, sustained commitment, mercy, and preserving companionship; I infer a distributed form of caring witness that counters the focus subject's isolation. A live alternative is that these are adjacent communal virtues and do not redefine the seeing relation itself.

changed_reading.before: Being seen means exposure before an external watcher.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting reading makes visibility communal and reparative: people keep one another seen through trusted counsel, endurance, mercy, and company.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context distinguishes lack of sight from active covering. Manifest signs are covered, while a fire perceptible from afar ends inside an emphatically closed enclosure. The subject's imagined private blind spot thus hardens into chosen occlusion and then reverses into an enclosure that marks and contains him.

activation_trace.role: Supposition supplies the initial imagined invisibility that the closing reversal materializes.
Seeing supplies the contested relation between manifest evidence, its coverer, and the final visible consequence.
Covering and concealing supply an active operation that replaces mere absence of perception.
A manifest sign supplies visible evidence available to be recognized or deliberately covered.
A fire perceived from afar defeats the fantasy that enclosure necessarily removes the subject from visibility.
Closing tightly over something supplies the final material reversal of the self-chosen blind spot.

structural_cues: 90:19 places covering directly against manifest signs.
The final ayah combines fire with an adjective of emphatic closure, ending the surah in a visibility-enclosure tension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, a manifest sign, fire visible from afar, and tight enclosure; I infer a trajectory from imagined observerlessness through active occlusion to imposed containment that still marks its occupant. A live alternative is that the final closure is solely punitive consequence and need not answer the earlier visual metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The subject imagines that privacy means simply not being seen.
changed_reading.after: The context distinguishes invisibility from covering: he suppresses manifest signs, only for the desired blind spot to return as a closed and still conspicuous enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it follows the packet's non-dominant split mapping from ر ء ي to ر و ي rather than the ordinary verbal sense of يَرَهُ. It remains anchored because the packet explicitly preserves the report-transmission branch and places a circulating utterance immediately before the focus. Render it only as an exploratory narrative-control activation, never as a lexical translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb يَرَهُ is the source occurrence resolved to the non-dominant report branch, while يَحْسَبُ can involve seeking or testing information.

activation_trace.role: Relaying reports and poetry recasts an eyewitness event as evidence that can be narrated onward.
Seeking out and testing information supplies the inquiry by which a self-authored report might be checked.
A saying that spreads among people supplies the social channel through which the boast can circulate or be countered.

changed_reading.before: He supposes there was no eyewitness.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he supposes his self-narration cannot be met by a counter-report because no observed event can travel through another narrator.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the cushion sense of ح س ب is not a plausible direct gloss of يَحْسَبُ. It remains useful as a material analogy anchored in the focus root and activated by accumulated, layered wealth. Downstream prose should state that wealth 'cushions' the supposition figuratively, not claim that the verb means sitting on a cushion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus reckoning is carried by يَحْسَبُ, whose inventory contains a small prop or cushion image.

activation_trace.role: A small cushion or prop materializes the support on which the subject's confidence rests.
Accumulated wealth supplies the social and material padding that can make the subject feel insulated.
Material layered one part over another gives the imagined insulation thickness and weight.

changed_reading.before: His error is a purely cognitive miscalculation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, piled wealth props and cushions that miscalculation, making material insulation feel like insulation from sight and account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the human-as-pupil image to the mirror and appearance branch of seeing. It remains anchored in يَرَهُ and in the packet's explicit إنسان العين branch, then gains a literal eye in 90:8. Render it as an anatomical-poetic activation about leaving an image in another's sight, not as the sentence's settled semantics.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The object pronoun in يَرَهُ makes the human figure an image available to another's eye or reflective surface.

activation_trace.role: Mirror, visible appearance, and facial sign supply the human as an image held on a perceiving surface.
The 'human of the eye' and human image in its black center make personhood itself a visual imprint.
The literal observing eye gives the image-bearing surface an explicit bodily location.

changed_reading.before: He believes no observer registers his presence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he imagines his human form leaves no image in another eye, although the context makes the human and the eye mutually image-bearing.

strongest_changes: The repeated frame of 90:5 and 90:7 separates immediate power from latent observation: lack of restraint does not entail lack of witness.
The boast about piled wealth becomes an auditable claim whose strongest visible trace is not self-report but nourishment reaching a hungry recipient.
The gift of two eyes reverses the gaze, making the supposedly watched man responsible for seeing nearby isolated people.
The closing movement from covering manifest signs to a fire in tight enclosure reverses desired invisibility into conspicuous containment.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several non-equivalent readings at once: zero-witness supposition, defective accounting, asymmetric visibility, spectator-made merit, civic evidence, reciprocal care, and outcome-based audit. The packet's split mappings also yielded contained but live report, cushion, and pupil-image activations that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The parallel questions in 90:5 and 90:7 may expose a causal fallacy from impunity to invisibility, or they may simply accumulate two independent delusions.
The reversal from 'who sees him?' to 'whom does he see?' is structurally powerful but remains a reader-supplied ethical arrow.
The expenditure audit may test factual truth, moral motive, recipient-side effect, or all three without forcing one exclusive level.
The report, cushion, watched-neck, and human-in-the-eye activations should remain explicitly exploratory branch-level images rather than lexical claims.
